description: David Kim, your average guy-who-cannot-die, and his eerie lifestyle. Xombi is approached by the surreal TWILIGHT, and the serrated RAINSAW, both of whom want a piece of him!

issue_title: Silent Cathedrals Part One: The Rabbit Hole
description:
Plot

Two strange and pious investigators named Catholic Girl and Nun of the Above track down a horde of frogs who arrived in this world by way of a teleportational slipstream. After interviewing the frogs at length, they discovered that Doctor Sugarman has escaped.

Meanwhile at Organitek, biochemist David Kim welcomes his new assistant, Kelly Sanborne, to the company. He introduces her to the rest of the staff and shows her his work with nanotechnology. Kim has been working on a process that uses nanites to repair and regrow damaged cell tissue. He takes samples of his own blood and infects them with the Polio virus as part of an experiment to prove the nanites' efficiency.

In another part of the building, the ghosts of insect colonies take the form of an over-sized homunculi, or, "rustling husks" and begin systematically killing all of the company's staff and security guards. The homonculi eventually make their way to David Kim's lab and attack him. The creatures leave Kim for dead and steal a computer disk. As he lies bleeding, Kim has Kelly Sanborne treat him with his nanite-infected blood samples.

The nanites begin restructuring Kim's damaged tissue, but in order for the process to work, the nanites need to assimilate matter from an alternative source. In this case, the source is Kelly Sanborne.
Part 4 of the 6-part 'School of Anguish.' Julian Parker and Rabbi Sinnowitz's betrayer stands revealed: Xombi himself has delivered them into the clutches of the sinister cult Beli Mah.
Part 5 of the 6-part 'School of Anguish.' It's do or die for Xombi and Rabbi Sinnowitz as they enter their final and bloodiest confrontation with the Beli Mah.
Part 6 of the 6-part 'School of Anguish.' David Kim enters a phase of personal turmoil when he faces his friends with the truth about Xombi.

Local legend in Dakota maintains that a clan of Kinderessen - supernatural creatures that feed on children - lurks in the caverns beneath Paris Island. Now the old wives' tale becomes a text of horror for the young Rabbi Sinnowitz.

issue_title: The Soul If An Old Machine
description: Xombi and Cheryl Saltz (from HARDWARE) must battle with the ghost of the first super-computer, Univac.

issue_title: Hidden Cities Chapter 2: The Serpent's Tale
Hidden Cities Chapter 3: City in the Clouds
Silent Cathedrals Part Two: Feats of Clay
description: David Kim escapes from the police, only to run into Rabbi and two Golems! Xombi the man who doesn't die, isn't even the FIFTH most bizarre creature in this issue!

Xombi's journey through mystical realms continues as David Kim meets Lady Kameko, a 40,000 year-old woman who began a love affair with David...eighty years in the future. Plus, Xombi learns that his ultimate destiny may spell disaster for Earth.

Extra-Sized Final Issue! Rabbi Sinnowitz and Xombi continue their journey through the Shadow Worlds, where David Kim discovers a land of impossible wonders, as well as many shocking secrets about himself. Unknown to them, a careless act in the course of their journey has released the Shadow Worlds' most fearsome captives, the Boogeyman Dread, into our world.

issue_title: Silent Cathedrals Part Three: Screaming Meat
description: Catholic Girl gets caught between a meat man some lesion dogs, as XOMBI and JULIAN PARKER prepare for the FOUR STABLE BOYS OF THE APOCALYPSE!
Part 4 of the 6-part 'Silent Cathedrals.' The villainous Dr. Sugarman stands at the threshold of immortality when he catches up to David Kim and Nun of the Above.

issue_title: Silent Cathedrals Part Five: The Lord of Fumes
description: Part 5 of the 6-part 'Silent Cathedrals.' Dr. Sugarman summons foulness from the depths of the Earth to contend with David Kim and Catholic Girl, and with the rest of the mystic coterie.

Part 6 of the 6-part 'Silent Cathedrals.' Back from his sojourn in the bizarre Garden of Spires, Xombi returns to his laboratory in a desperate attempt to resurrect Kelly Sanborne, whom he inadvertently killed when he first got his regenerative powers.

Part 1 of the 6-part 'School of Anguish.' Xombi witnesses a murder-for-hire that goes horribly wrong when he crosses the path of Manuel Dexterity, a "hand-centaur" - a creature that is human from the waist up...and a hand from the waist down. While trying to prevent more deaths, Xombi stumbles upon a sinster cult.

Part 2 of the 6-part 'School of Anguish.' Following his strange encounter with Manuel Dexterity, Xombi becomes the target of Painful Inscriptions, the Beli Mah cult's bizarre agents of anguish and death. Xombi falls victim to beings like Bludgeon, who was crafted from misdirected rage, and Blister Ed, a construct of words spoken in anger.

Part 3 of the 6-part 'School of Anguish.' A traitor to the Beli Mah seeks the help of Xombi and Julian Parker, leading them to the School of Anguish, whose graduates include Dexterities, Depression Annie and Doubting Thomas. Now the Beli Mah has everything it needs to rid itself of Xombi - once and for all.
Rocky runs away from the orphanage, meets Lassie and, later, Ben, and secures a job with coffee planter Mr. Lawrence.

Facts about Old Ben, a police dog from London, England.

A Week End Away From School; Lassie, Rocky and Gerry go with professor Graham and his wife to their cottage to spend a weekend; They find the cottage occupied by Joesy and Greg, who are expecting Harry and the boss any minute.

Lassie Helps Cupid; Lyda-Sue, a new student at Bixley Heath College, is persuaded by Cliff to go to the beach with Rocky to make Gerry angry.

Lassie Plays a Part; Rocky and Lassie go to watch a rehearsal of the varsity play, causing Cliff to walk out; Gerry suggests Rocky as a substitute though he has only two days to memorize his part.

Facts about sheep and sheepdogs.

A Trip to the Everglades, Missing the sightseeing launch, Gerry, Rocky and Lassie hire a small private boat to take them to the Everglades.

Lassie Leads the Way, Lassie, Rocky and Gerry take the Lathams to a moonlight picnic.

Make Like an Aspirin, Cliff tricks Gerry into helping him study for next week's exams.

A Day at the Beach, Adventure with a small shark.

Facts about the bald eagle and the golden eagle.

Tennis, Anyone?; Lassie interrupts a game of tennis with a stick which turns out to carry a help-message.

Blood Donor; On a car ride, Gerry, Rocky and Lassie encounter a young boy and his puppy; The puppy has been hit by a car.

Surprises; While preparing for the final exams at college, Gerry receives a cable from Mr. Lawrence, saying that he'll fly over for graduation.

Facts about the Matto Grosso.

Gerry and Rocky travel to Brazil to set up their homestead in the wilderness, bringing Ben and Lassie with them; They hire Jose dos Patos as their guide.

Jungle Weapons; Facts about bows and arrows.

The White Jewel; Lassie spots an unconscious man, Marc Lauro, in a canoe; He is trying to bring a big diamond safely to Goias, but he is pursued by Herman Klemm and Pedro Verde.

Mission Accomplished; Gerry, Rocky and Lassie fly to New York to meet Rocky's publisher; Lassie leaves the briefcase with the manuscript behind to save a child at the airport. From the hotel, Lassie sets out to retrieve it.

Marooned in the Jungle; Flying back to their homestead, our friends are caught by a storm, forcing capitao Jorge to crash-land the plane in the jungle; Gerry, Rocky and Lassie stay at a Bororo village known to capitao Jorge, while he goes for help.

Facts about the toucan, the sloth, the manatee, the rhea, and the armadillo.

Roundup in Rio, Gerry, Rocky and Lassie fly to Rio de Janeiro for a Mardi Gras holiday; A pickpocket, cornered by Lassie, gets away with the help of Diavolo. Diavolos's master, Gorey, has plans for a big hotel robbery.

Lassie and the Forest of Flame, Back at the homestead Lassie alerts our friends to a cloud of smoke; Using the bulldozer they quickly get to the neighboring estancia which is threatened by a forest fire.

Lassie Finds a New Friend, On a hunting trip our friends encounter a young indian, Timbu, sole survivor of the Taquari tribe, and bring him back to the homestead.

Facts about the Gauchos of Argentina, the Pearl Divers of Venezuela, the Hat Weavers of Ecuador, and the Llanero of Colombia.

Adrift on the Amazon, Rocky, Gerry, Lassie, and Timbu set out on a mission to take photographs of the Amazon during the rainy season; Losing their canoe, they pitch camp on a small island, which later sets adrift down the river.

The Legend of the Golden Mountain, While Gerry and Rocky go to Goias for supplies, Timbu sets out on a search for a lost gold mine.

The Wilderness Road, Rocky is appointed supervisor of the road-building engineers. Sayao and his men try to sabotage construction of the road.

Facts about the Harpy Eagle, the Howler Monkey, the Peccary, the Capybara, and the Hoactzin.

The Jungle Princess, Lassie helps a jaguar cub and makes friends with his wounded mother Cheena. Illegal trapper Roderico tries to capture both.

Lassie Collars a Thief, On the way to New York Gerry and Rocky buy a new collar for Lassie which is to be engraved by senhor Emile, a jeweler. He has other plans.

The Mercy Mission, Lassie and Timbu round up a herd of cattle for senhor Rovera, but Timbu gets hurt by an alligator.

Facts about the Indians of Lake Titicaca, the Bonis of Guiana, the Lumbermen of the Chaco, and the Caribs of Venezuela.

Secret of the Jungle, Our friends are met by a group of Umari indians led by chief Arujo; They seek José's advice regarding possible sale of a piece of land to Barbosso.

Fight for Freedom, Capitao Jorge enters Lassie in a dog show, but Caracas has plans for the Prince de Paris to win.

The Vanishing Trail, Lassie, Gerry and Rocky go on a mission to find the missing Dr. Ramirez.

Facts about the Condor, the Umbrella Bird, Cock-of-the-Rock, and the Trumpeter Bird.

The Black Jaguar, Lassie and her friends go hunting for a cattle-killing black tiger.

The Lost City, Lassie and her friends, on a photo mission to Cuzco, search for the lost city of Uma-Picchu.

The Jungle Courier, Lassie and her friends meet a group of settlers who have been driven off their homesteads by Don Sodero; Lassie and Timbu go downstream to intercept the mail canoe which supposedly carries a proof of their ownership.
Nary and Ribold break the safe at the Lawrence plantation; They take Rocky and Ben with them to make it look like they were the thieves.

Facts about the Spectacled Bear, the Coati, the Kinkajou, and the Patagonian Cavy.

The Fiery Mountain, After their adventures in Peru (in issue #19), Lassie and her friends fly towards Quito in a chartered plane on their way to the USA; The plane is wrecked by debris from a volcanic eruption.

The Concrete Jungle, Arrived at New York, Gerry and Rocky leave Timbu and Lassie at the hotel for a while; Timbu takes Lassie for a trip of city exploration.

Down to the Sea, Lassie and her friends go to Maine to visit Rocky's publisher, Mr. Carver, and his son Ricky; Ricky takes Timbu and Lassie on a sailing trip to catch giant tuna.

Facts about Corn, Chocolate, the Peanut, and the Pineapple.

Marooned, Lassie and her friends leave Maine on Mr. Carver's power cruiser to go to Florida; With them is Mr. Ralph Jager, a staff illustrator, who does not fancy dogs.

The Man Who Vanished, Returning to the homestead in the Matto Grosso, Lassie and her friends expect to be met by Lalo, the caretaker, but instead they meet Pablo Mira and two thief-takers who are hunting Lalo for the murder of Mira's partner Tomas.

Treasure of the Orinoco, Traveling up the Orinoco in search for the nesting grounds of the scarlet ibis, Lassie, Gerry and Rocky meet the Akawos.

Facts about Minas Gerais.

The Flying Wolf, Lassie plays with a group of howler monkeys, which afterwards run off with Rocky's camera, and a harpy eagle flies off with the young howler monkey; Lassie to the rescue.

The Nature Lover; Dr. Blithley of the National Botanical Institute arrives at the homestead to get some specimens from the jungle; He is persuaded to take Timbu and Lassie with him on his day trip into the jungle.

The Isle of Adventure, Lassie and her friends explore an island off the coast of Peru.

The Treasure of Lima, Lassie and her friends fly to Lima to see Senhor Vega of the Peruvian National Museum; Vega's assistant Dr. Ricardo has plans to take over the museum with the aid of false treasure provided by senhor Paraces.

Storm Over the Pampas, Lassie and her friends fly to Argentina to visit the Madeira ranch; Inspired by the riders' rhea hunt, young Pedro takes Lassie on a hunting trip. Forest of Fear; On their way home from Argentina Lassie and her friends land in Asunción.

The Warrior, Lassie and her friends visit senhor Rohas who has bought a stallion, Warrior; Warrior is entered in the national cup race at Rio, and Lassie joins senior Rohas and Warrior for the trip. Pedro Volta, the hired jockey, is dismissed after using the whip on Warrior, but he plans to get back on senior Rohas.

Jungle Rivals, Lassie and Timbu meet a group of Juru Indians; Dino, the son of the chief, challenges Timbu to a contest and decides that Lassie is Timbu's good luck charm. The Law of the Jungle text story.

The Guardian, Aligra and Landon, two no-gooders, hear Lalo speaking of the two prize calves; They steal the calves but are followed by Lassie.

Facts about Lima, capital of Peru. Facts about Bolivia. Facts about the Boxer (animal).

The Hunter's Prey, Mark Gorin, a trophy hunter, visits the homestead with plans to shoot a jaguar; Having his eyes set on Cheena and her cub, he doesn't count on Lassie being a friend of the jaguar.

Message of Mercy, Senhor Terin is in charge of building a telephone line through the jungle; The Jurus think it is evil magic and start tearing it down, but a falling pole hits Dino.

Treasure of the Andes, Gerry and Rocky are off on another photo expedition into the jungle, but they find it hard to find a guide.

Facts about Rio de Janeiro. Facts about the Brazilian diamond hunter. Facts about the English Bulldog.

The Trembling Mountains, Lassie and her friends parachute down to earthquake-stricken Santanna; Medical supplies are flown in and dropped by parachute but drift away. Lassie to the rescue!

Danger in the Deep, On vacation at the Copacabana, Gerry and Rocky leave Lassie ashore while they go swimming; Lassie meets Paulo, a fisherman, who has had trouble with a shark.

The Golden Goddess, On their way home from Belem, Lassie and her friends are forced to crash-land.

Facts about the Araucanians. Facts about the Chinchilla. Facts about the Irish Setter.

Valley of the Lost, Lassie and her friends find a hidden Maya city in Yucatan, Mexico; Sanchez tries to get away with some of the city's treasure of gold.

Mountain Rescue, Lassie and her friends visit senhor Rincon's sheep ranch at Lake Titicaca, Bolivia; A condor steals a lamb but is rescued by Lassie.

Lassie Meets the Emperor, Gerry and Rocky help Senhor Vargas hunt Emperor, a bull which has run away with a herd of cows.

Trouble on the River, Gerry and Rocky set off downriver towards Santaro floating some hardwood logs; On their way Lassie helps save the passengers of a riverboat from a flood.

Message from the Sky, Rocky intercepts a carrier pigeon with a message for Cupac, an Indian renegade who raids villages for slaves for his hidden rubber plantation.

King of the Amazon, Lassie and her friends go to Rosario where a fiesta is to be held to raise money for a hospital.

Facts about the St. Bernard.

A brief history and description of the dalmation.

The Sea Devil, In Colombia Rocky and Gerry, with Lassie, decide to help Buff Saunders, an old friend, find an old foundered Spanish treasure ship.

The Green Flame; Rocky and Gerry, with Lassie, travel to a Colombian emerald mine that apparently is exhausted.

Reina The Black Panther, A hunter and his son Mateo want to kill Reina for her hide, but then stop because she is defending her cubs.

The Race For Life; Rocky and Gerry, with Lassie, go to Quito in Ecuador for the inauguration of a new railroad line where Vernal, the chief engineer, has a dispute with Arbolon, a worker.
Mr. Lawrence, Gerry, Rocky and Lassie sail on a treasure hunt guided by Mr. Slinger, Shorty and Otto; Having reached an island with a sunken Spanish galleon, they are in for a surprise.

The Thieftakers, Bandits, who have taken crop money from Rocky, take refuge in Rocky's homestead; Lassie and Timbu save the day by laying traps for the bandits to fall into.

Desperate Journey, Rocky and Gerry, with Lassie, bring supplies to their homestead in a canoe; A storm forces them to stop while Lassie is whisked away in the current.

Reina The Black Panther, A heavy rain causes a river to flood and all the jungle animals search for higher ground.

Gift From The Sea; Rocky and Gerry, with Lassie, go to Cape Horn to do film sequences on the South American Yagan Indian tribe.

Danger Ahead, The mayor of Rosario asks Rocky to act as a guide and advisor for the engineers who are going to build a new railroad. Serdo and Magre try to get the other truckers to sabotage the building of the railroad, so they can take over their businesses, expecting truck traffic to increase after the railroad has been built.

Boy of the Wilderness, Lassie, Rocky and Timbu visit Luis Gomes to make a series of photos on the life of a seringueiro (rubber gatherer).

Lassie Finds a Star, In the jungle, Lassie helps a colt fight off a jacare (alligator).

Jungle Spitfire, Rocky, Gerry and Lassie find and help heal a wounded ocelot; Once freed, the ocelot returns the favor when Lassie is in deadly trouble.

The New House, Rocky is building a new house for himself but every time Lassie tries to help something goes wrong.

Reina The Black Panther, Paolo, a gold prospector, works by a stream and has become accustomed to Reina's presence.

The Test, Rocky and Gerry go to New York and leave Timbu and Lassie in Brazil at the farm of Alberto Jorge.

City of the Caesars, A brief account of a fabled lost city.

Raider's on the River; Rocky, Gerry and Lassie help a trader who was attacked by river pirates on the upper Amazon River.

The Treacherous Tide; Rocky helps a friend of his investigate a possible oil drilling scam.

Track of the Tigre, A mother leopard hunts to feed her cubs and fights for survival in the Amazon Jungle.

The Winged Warrior; A young Indian boy prepares to face his test of manhood.

Facts about the port city of Maracaibo.

Return of the Jungle God; Lassie, Rocky, and Dr. Bates travel the Amazon in search of a lost native city but are taken captive by Mochi Indians; Lassie escapes but returns to dig Rocky and Dr. Bates from their prison hut.

Wings of Courage; Lassie carries an injured duck to the homestead and the bird mends under the care of Rocky and Gerry.

Treasure of the Rio Branco; When Rocky's friend Marc is robbed of a valuable diamond, Rocky and Lassie travel to Diamonte, a mining camp, to find the thief.

Farewell to Rio; When Lassie develops a deadly allergy to a grass in the Amazonian jungle, Rocky and Gerry find a home for her with friends in the American Midwest.

The New Home; Lassie arrives in the United States and meets the Miller family but is lost and held in a forest shack by two penniless tramps who plan to sell her.

Test of Fire; Lassie, Jeff, Porky, and Pokey go camping but are trapped in a forest fire set by a careless camper.

Mystery Bone, Lassie finds a dinosaur bone.

Untitled Blaze story, Blaze is swept away by a flood. The Chain text story.

Lassie's Vanity, Lassie gets the full treatment in a dog grooming shop.

The Runaway, The Millers find a runaway boy hiding in their barn.

A Lesson in Flames; Timmy accidentally sets a treehouse on fire.

The Battle of the Bulls; Blaze is caught between two battling bulls.

Challenge of the Wild; Timmy brings home a wolf pup.
On leaving Piranga Islands with the treasure, the Sprite II is caught by a tidal wave and taken to land, leaving room for more encounters with the mutineers from issue #3.

Heart of a Dog; Paul and Ruth Martin buy the Miller farm and adopt Timmy.

Winds of Fury; Blaze saves a calf during a tornado.

Forest Guardian; Poachers threaten Lassie's forest friends.

Lassie, Gerry, Rocky, and Mr. Lawrence leave Rio de Janeiro to search for the other half of a parchment describing the location of more treasure; Their plane, piloted by Bill Crawford, crashes in a treetop in the jungle.

Mr. Lawrence is called to Florida, so instead of going on a treasure hunt in the Amazon jungle, our friends fly to Miami, Florida; After a short stay at the Alexander's, Gerry, Rocky and Lassie head north in a rented car to join Mr. Lawrence in St. Petersburg, but they are detoured by three strangers, Slim, Fuzzy and Luke.

Lassie and the Fountain of Youth, Rocky plays a joke on Gerry using a young collie borrowed from the watchman at the fountain of youth.
Mr. Lawrence buys a horse, Lady Lulu, who will run at the race track only with Lassie running along; Teddy, Jeep and Norman try to make a fast buck betting against Lady Lulu.

Mr. Lawrence has to go to England; Gerry and Rocky enter Bixley Heath College and Lassie gets to stay with Rocky after rescuing the dean's son from drowning.

Lassie Saves a Date, Cliff challenges Rocky to a race to see who gets to take Gerry to the soph dance.

Lassie Horns In; Cliff runs out of gas driving Gerry to town to send a cable. Rocky and Cliff both want to try out for the basketball team.

Lassie Catches a Big One; On a trip to the beach on her own Lassie gets sold to a guy who teaches her a new trick: Fetch the elephant from the mantle.

A Cutup Can't Cut In; Rocky takes a job at the cleaner's to earn money to take Gerry to the formal. Cliff has plans to prevent Rocky from going, but he doesn't count on Lassie.
"The Westward Passage," To commemorate the 500th Anniversary of Christopher Columbus's voyage to America, Archie writes a composition and imagines participating in the journey

"I Told You So!", During an expedition at Mystic Lake, Archie encounters a sea monster and its Viking protectors; He returns to civilization with a horn from a Viking Warrior's helmet as proof, but no one believes him; Later, at Veronica's party, Betty blows on the horn and the Vikings suddenly reappear, take back the horn and disappear again.

"Plain Jane," At the fair, Archie befriends a girl nicknamed "Plain Jane", but he finds out that she is anything but plain.

"Rainy Day for Two!", Archie and Veronica share an umbrella much to Betty's dismay.

"Teed Off!", Veronica helps her father by playing golf with his business associate, but during the game she sees Archie and Betty together and schemes to break them up.

"When Rhinos Fly!", Movie star Throbb Temple turns out to be a coward when a promotional event turns dangerous for Archie and Veronica.

"Grammar Grapple," The girls are jealous when they see Archie with new student Roxie Lee.

"Chain Reaction," The Andrews' daily paper for November 23 somehow arrives a day early, which allows Archie the chance to change history.

issue_title: I'll Be Seeing You!; Tough Sledding!; The Golden Ghost of Gusty Gap!
description:
• "I'll Be Seeing You!", Veronica smuggles Archie aboard the Lodge's yacht as a waiter, because she doesn't want to leave him behind while she's on vacation.
  • "Tough Sledding!", Archie tries to improve his grade in business class by starting a business of his own - selling snacks to ice fishers.
  • "The Golden Ghost of Gusty Gap!", The legendary ghost of Gusty Gap appears to save Archie from a skiing accident. reprinted in Archie & Friends Double Digest #23.

"The Lost Egg," Mr. Lodge sends Riverdale's students on a field trip to Canada, to cover for Veronica's mission to help him acquire a priceless jeweled Fromagé egg for his collection while she is there.

"The Real Thing," The boys visit a new year-round indoor beach in town which has all the things you would expect in a beach, except the girls.

"Letting Off Steam," Jughead encourages Archie to let out his frustration at being bullied by Moose, but Moose overhears them and goes after Archie again.

"He-Man Suit," When a crooked scientist tries to steal the prototype super-suit that Lodge Industries is developing for the military, Archie dons the suit to stop the crime, and to save Veronica from being kidnapped.

"The Gold Egyptian Cat," Archie and Jughead receive a memento after a job as movie extras, and fantasize about how much they can make from selling it as a collectible.

"This Old House," When the gang learns that an old house in town has been condemned and will be demolished, they each recall past trips inside the house, which is believed to be haunted, and decide to learn more about its history.

issue_title: Campaign in the Neck!; Not-So-Private Eye; Back to the 70's

description:
"Chapter 1, Return of The Tree"; Christmas season stress and mishaps for Archie and the gang as seen by Piney at the Lodge house.

"Chapter 2, Tree's Company"; Archie's holiday job at the post office is to answer letters to Santa and he enlists the rest of the gang to help.

"Chapter 3, Simply Tree-Mendous"; Archie and the gang set to planning a big Christmas event for all the people who wrote letters to Santa.

"Chapter 4, A Tree For All Seasons"; The big Christmas event comes together even better than anyone had anticipated.

"Riverdale Roughriders, Part I", Mr. Lodge brings Veronica and her friends to his new investment, a Western ranch where they take lessons in riding and roping.

"Trail Troubles!, Part II", Following their cowboy training, Archie and the gang go along on a cattle drive, but an accident starts a stampede.

"Ride Like the Wind!, Part III", The teens help stop the stampede, but later, Mr. Lodge disappears; Reggie (who has brought along his portable television) learns that Tex and Willie are wanted criminals.

"Showdown!, Part IV", The teens rescue Mr. Lodge from his kidnappers, and he promises not to make any changes to Cactus Slim's ranch.
"The Riverdale Weirdleys," Archie meets the strange Weirdley family (and their attractive cousin Zandra) and finds himself involved in a mystery over their grandfather's missing fortune.

"Its All Downhill," Archie is injured while competing against Reggie in a downhill sled race.

"First Time In-Line" Archie & Friends illustration by Rex Lindsey.

"Boast of the Town!", Reggie tries to convince Riverdale that Archie was not injured in their sled race because he swerved to avoid a small child, but because he couldn't control his sled.

"On the Road Again!", Reggie saves Archie's life when Archie's wheelchair gets caught on the city bus.
